subject: TrustBridge Whistic onboarding & evidence plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: onboarding@trustbridge.io
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TrustBridge Whistic profile & evidence upload — kickoff

Hi Maya / TrustBridge onboarding team,

Thanks for agreeing to get us set up on your Whistic profile. We’d like to get an initial intake completed this week so procurement and security can start the CAIQ/SIG reconciliation. High-level asks: 

- Portal access (owner-level) for Redwood: jonas@redwoodinference.com
- SSO/SAML integration details or a service account for bulk uploads
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) + SOC scope summary
- CAIQ mapping template or CSV export of your profile (if available)
- Evidence for KMS rotation and encryption-in-transit (S3 bucket or cert names)

If you have a checklist we can follow, please drop it in your reply or share a short onboarding doc. If there's a preferred time for a 30-min kickoff, I can take 10am PT on Monday or Tuesday.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
From: Maya Patel <maya@trustbridge.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge Whistic profile & evidence upload — kickoff

Hi Jonas — lovely to meet you over email.

We're ready to get you into our Whistic workspace. Quick answers to your bullets: 

- I'll provision an owner-role invite for jonas@redwoodinference.com and send the link within the hour.
- We support SAML and can either add a SSO service account for programmatic uploads or provide manual bulk upload. If you prefer programmatic, please send your SP metadata or an admin contact for SAML exchange.
- SOC 2: we can upload the redacted SOC 2 Type II and a scope summary — delivery ETA is EOD Monday.
- We can export a CAIQ CSV; I will attach our onboarding mapping and a step-by-step PDF.
- KMS/Encryption: we have an evidence bundle for KMS rotation and TLS certs; please tell me the file naming convention you prefer for evidence.

Attaching: TrustBridge_Whistic_Onboarding_Step-By-Step.pdf (attachment)

Would Monday 10:00am PT work for a short kickoff?

Best,
Maya Patel
Onboarding Lead, TrustBridge
[Attachment: TrustBridge_Whistic_Onboarding_Step-By-Step.pdf]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@trustbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge Whistic profile & evidence upload — kickoff

Thanks Maya — that PDF is perfect. Looping in Marissa (Security Ops) and Ben (Procurement) to coordinate evidence expectations and procurement timeline. Quick notes for the kickoff: 

- Marissa will own CAIQ/SIG mapping and will need CSV export or a CAIQ template we can import.
- Ben will confirm PO/contracting cadence once we identify any bespoke terms.
- Please upload the SOC 2 redacted copy and a short scope summary (one page) to the profile before the kickoff if possible.

I pasted Maya’s guidance below for context.

On Fri, May 7, 2027 at 11:03 AM Maya Patel <maya@trustbridge.io> wrote:
> We're ready to get you into our Whistic workspace. Quick answers to your bullets: 
> - I'll provision an owner-role invite for jonas@redwoodinference.com and send the link within the hour.
> - We support SAML and can either add a SSO service account for programmatic uploads or provide manual bulk upload. If you prefer programmatic, please send your SP metadata or an admin contact for SAML exchange.

Marissa / Ben — suggested deliverables from TrustBridge before the call: SOC2 (redacted), CAIQ CSV export or mapping, and KMS/TLS evidence bundle.

I can meet for a 30-min kickoff at 10:00am PT — confirm if that works and Maya will send a calendar invite.

— Jonas
[Attachment: none]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@trustbridge.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrustBridge Whistic profile & evidence upload — kickoff

Hi Maya — thanks, and welcome. I’ll run the CAIQ/SIG reconciliation once we have the CSV; below is the evidence manifest we'd like uploaded to the profile in a single folder to keep audit logs tidy. Please confirm approximate file sizes if any artifact is >50MB so we can arrange SFTP instead of UI upload.

Required items (preferred filenames in parentheses):

1) SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — SOC2_Redacted_TrustBridge_2026.pdf
2) SOC scope summary (1 page) — SOC2_Scope_TrustBridge_2026.pdf
3) CAIQ CSV export or template mapping — CAIQ_mapping_template.csv (we'll import into our reconciliation tool)
4) Evidence bundle for KMS rotation (signed manifest + key IDs) — KMS_Rotation_TrustBridge_manifest.json (if you prefer, a signed PDF is okay)
5) TLS cert chain evidence for public endpoints — TLS_Certs_TrustBridge.zip
6) IAM/service account audit log snippet for the last 90 days (CSV) — IAM_audit_trustbridge_90d.csv

Optional but helpful: internal penetration test summary (redacted), vendor vulnerability tracker export.

Timeline/next steps:
- Upload the required items to the Whistic folder before the kickoff at 10:00am PT tomorrow (May 11). If you can't meet that, please upload anything available and flag missing items.
- If any artifact is sensitive and you prefer a signed Docusign or secured sftp, indicate and we'll provide an upload endpoint.

Ben — please take point on contracting once evidence scope is confirmed.

Maya — can you confirm the owner invite has been sent and whether the CSV export will be available? Also confirm the file size for TLS_Certs_TrustBridge.zip if possible.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Request_List.xlsx]
